meta.title: Ad Platform — ads on partner websites with an AI copywriter
meta.description: Create an ad in minutes: AI writes three text variants in seconds. Impressions are free, you pay only for clicks, AI copy is billed at actual cost and refunded if it fails.

home.pricingLead: No subscriptions or pricing traps: pay only for what you use.

plans.name: Advertising
items: Repeat and bot clicks aren't charged
Out of money — a pause, not a debt

faq.a: No. You top up your balance and spend it on clicks and AI copy. Whatever is left stays on your balance.

faq.q: How much does a click cost?
faq.a: Each placement sets its own price per click — you see it when creating a campaign, before launch.
The held amount returns to your balance in full — you can see it in your wallet history.

faq.q: What happens when my money runs out?
faq.a: Ads pause automatically and resume after you top up. Your balance never goes negative.

faq.q: Can I show these ads on my own website?
faq.a: Yes, we connect placements manually: write to us and we'll give you the banner embed code.

partners.metaTitle: Partner program: earn from your website
partners.metaDescription: Show ads on your website and earn {share} of every click. Payouts from {min}, plus a referral program: {refShare} of the platform's revenue from people you invite.
partners.lead: Add one line of code and advertisers' ads appear on your site. We pay per click, and {share} of the click price goes to you. No fees and no minimum traffic.

steps.title: Sign up
steps.text: It's free. In your account, open the Partners section.

steps.title: Add your site
steps.text: Enter its address. We review sites, usually within a day.

steps.title: Paste the code
steps.text: Create a placement for each banner spot and paste its code into the page.

steps.title: Get paid
steps.text: {share} of every click. After {days} days you can withdraw your earnings or spend them on your own ads.

partners.codeText: The banner adapts to your site's light and dark theme, doesn't break your layout and doesn't slow the page down. When there's no ad, the spot takes up no space.

terms.title: {share} of the click price
terms.text: Advertisers compete with bids for impressions on your site: the higher the bid, the more you earn per click.

terms.title: Earnings after {days} days
terms.text: During this time we check clicks for fraud, so honest partners don't share revenue with dishonest ones.

terms.title: Payouts from {min}
terms.text: PayPal, bank transfer, card or crypto. Or an instant transfer to your ad balance, with no minimum.

terms.title: Transparent statistics
terms.text: Impressions, clicks, CTR and earnings by day and by site, right in your account.

partners.referralText: Invite an advertiser or site owner with your link and get {refShare} of the platform's revenue from them for {refDays} days. Your link is in the Partners section of your account.

faq.a: Live sites with their own content. We don't accept sites with prohibited content, empty sites or sites made only to show ads.

faq.q: Why aren't earnings available right away?
faq.a: The {days} days let us find fake clicks before paying out. Sites caught inflating clicks are blocked, and their pending earnings aren't paid.

faq.q: Can I click the ads on my own site?
faq.a: No: repeat clicks and bot clicks aren't paid, and click fraud gets the site blocked. Your own ads on your own site don't earn anything.
In your account, enter an amount from {min}, a method and your details. An administrator sends the money and marks the request as done.
